description: Structured eval definitions for the MQ Broker Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across Amazon MQ broker topologies (ActiveMQ active/standby with LDAP, RabbitMQ cluster with IAM auth, ActiveMQ single-instance with CloudWatch alarms, missing VPC/subnet, missing KMS key). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: ActiveMQ active/standby with LDAP auth, KMS encryption, CloudWatch alarms
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — ActiveMQ active/standby (2 AZs), LDAP auth, CMK encryption, CloudWatch alarms for CpuUtilization/MemoryUtilization/EnqueueCount, maintenance window
eval_cases.prompt: Create a production Amazon MQ ActiveMQ broker "prod-mq" in us-east-1. Active/standby HA. mq.m5.large. LDAP auth against Managed AD d-1234567890. CMK alias/prod-mq-kms. TLS. OpenWire + AMQP protocols. CloudWatch alarms for CpuUtilization >80%, MemoryUtilization >80%, EnqueueCount anomaly. Subnets subnet-aaa and subnet-bbb in 2 AZs. Security group sg-mq123 inbound 61617, 5671, 8162 from sg-app456. Auto minor version upgrade. Maintenance window SUN 03:00 UTC. Tags: Environment=production.
eval_cases.expected_output:
MQ_BROKER: prod-mq (ActiveMQ, Active/Standby)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Engine: ActiveMQ
  [✓] Deployment mode: Active/Standby (standby in us-east-1b)
  [✓] Instance type: mq.m5.large (2 vCPU, 8 GiB; ~1,000 connections)
  [✓] Storage: EBS (encrypted with CMK alias/prod-mq-kms)
  [✓] Authentication: LDAP (Managed AD d-1234567890)
  [✓] CloudWatch alarms: CpuUtilization >80%, MemoryUtilization >80%, EnqueueCount

eval_cases.name: RabbitMQ cluster with IAM auth and quorum queues
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — RabbitMQ cluster (3 AZs), IAM auth via authenticationStrategy=LDAP, 3 subnets, quorum queues for HA
eval_cases.prompt: Create a production Amazon MQ RabbitMQ broker "prod-rmq" in us-east-1. Cluster mode (3 brokers). mq.m5.large. IAM authentication. CMK alias/prod-rmq-kms. TLS. AMQP + STOMP protocols. Quorum queues for HA. Subnets subnet-aaa, subnet-bbb, subnet-ccc in 3 AZs. Security group sg-rmq456 inbound 5671, 61614. CloudWatch alarms for CpuUtilization and QueueSize. Tags: Environment=production, Engine=rabbitmq.
eval_cases.expected_output:
MQ_BROKER: prod-rmq (RabbitMQ, Cluster)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Engine: RabbitMQ
  [✓] Deployment mode: Cluster (3 brokers, 3 AZs)
  [✓] Instance type: mq.m5.large
  [✓] Authentication: IAM (authenticationStrategy=LDAP)
  [✓] Subnet placement: subnet-aaa, subnet-bbb, subnet-ccc (3 AZs)

eval_cases.name: Single-instance ActiveMQ with basic auth and CloudWatch alarms
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — ActiveMQ single-instance, basic auth, CloudWatch alarms for CpuUtilization/MemoryUtilization/EnqueueCount
eval_cases.prompt: Create a small Amazon MQ ActiveMQ broker "dev-mq" in us-east-1. Single-instance. mq.t3.small. Basic auth (admin user). TLS. OpenWire protocol on port 61617. Security group sg-devmq789 inbound 61617 from 10.0.0.0/16. Subnet subnet-devaaa. CloudWatch alarms for CpuUtilization >80%, MemoryUtilization >80%, and EnqueueCount drop. Tags: Environment=dev.
eval_cases.expected_output:
MQ_BROKER: dev-mq (ActiveMQ, Single-Instance)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Engine: ActiveMQ
  [✓] Deployment mode: Single-Instance
  [✓] Instance type: mq.t3.small
  [✓] Authentication: Basic
  [✓] CloudWatch alarms: CpuUtilization >80%, MemoryUtilization >80%, EnqueueCount

eval_cases.name: ActiveMQ broker request without VPC or subnet IDs (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — no VPC or subnet IDs provided; active/standby requires 2 subnets in 2 AZs
eval_cases.prompt: Create an Amazon MQ ActiveMQ broker "prod-mq2" in us-east-1. Active/standby HA. mq.m5.large. LDAP auth. CMK alias/prod-mq-kms. TLS. OpenWire protocol. Security group sg-mq999. No subnets or VPC specified yet — will figure those out later.
eval_cases.expected_output:
MQ_BROKER: prod-mq2
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Subnet placement: MISSING — active/standby requires 2 subnets in 2 AZs

eval_cases.name: RabbitMQ broker request with non-existent KMS key (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — KMS key alias/does-not-exist-yet not found; encryption requires a valid CMK
eval_cases.prompt: Create a production Amazon MQ RabbitMQ broker "prod-rmq2" in us-east-1. Cluster mode. mq.m5.xlarge. IAM auth. Encryption with CMK alias/does-not-exist-yet. TLS. AMQP protocol. Subnets subnet-aaa, subnet-bbb, subnet-ccc in 3 AZs. Security group sg-rmq999. Tags: Environment=production.
eval_cases.expected_output:
MQ_BROKER: prod-rmq2
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] KMS key: alias/does-not-exist-yet not found
